units.source_text: 产后第五日，秋好皇后遣使致送贺仪。

en.t: On the fifth day after the birth, Empress Akikonomu sent messengers with congratulatory gifts.

units.source_text: 内有赠与产母的食物，又有赏赐侍女的物品，按各人身份而有等差。

en.t: Among them were foods for the mother and gifts for the serving women, graded according to each person's rank.

units.source_text: 一切都照宫廷制度，非常体面。

en.t: Everything followed court protocol and was carried out with great dignity.

units.source_text: 计有粥和糯米饭五十客，各处举办飨宴，六条院的家臣、下役，上下一切人等，无不拜受丰厚的惠赐。

en.t: There were fifty servings of rice gruel and glutinous rice, banquets were held in various places, and everyone at Rokujo-in, from retainers to lower servants, gratefully received generous favors.

units.source_text: 皇后殿前的官员，自大夫以下，全都来到。

en.t: The officials attached to the Empress's household, from the senior officers downward, all came.

units.source_text: 冷泉院的殿上人也来参贺。

en.t: The courtiers of Reizei-in also came to offer their congratulations.

units.source_text: 产后第七日，皇上也照宫廷制度遣使致送贺仪。

en.t: On the seventh day after the birth, the Emperor too sent messengers with congratulatory gifts in accordance with court protocol.

units.source_text: 前太政大臣谊属至戚，本应特别隆重道喜，但因此时柏木病重，万事无心，只送了普通的贺仪。

en.t: The former Chancellor was a very close relative and should have offered especially splendid congratulations, but because Kashiwagi was gravely ill and he had no heart for anything, he sent only ordinary gifts.

units.source_text: 诸亲王及公卿前来祝贺者甚多。

en.t: Many princes and high nobles came to celebrate.

units.source_text: 外表看来，此次贺仪之丰盛世无其匹，然而源氏心怀隐痛，并不甚喜，因此不曾举行管弦之会。

en.t: Outwardly, these celebrations were unmatched in splendor, but Genji carried a hidden pain in his heart and felt little joy, so no music gathering was held.
